headline: GTA VI conquers the world, but faces a barrier in China: why can't it be officially sold?
summary: Rockstar Games' GTA VI has launched worldwide, but it does not have government authorisation to be sold in mainland China. Chinese players have shown strong anticipation for the game.
why: Take-Two Interactive owns Rockstar Games, and China is one of the largest video game markets, so access restrictions limit potential revenue. Regulatory approval is required for most foreign game sales in China.
original_headline: GTA VI conquista el mundo, pero enfrenta una barrera en China: ¿por qué no puede venderse oficialmente?
